newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Scorned Swedish hooker goes to court for her fee.
newsitem.headline: Scorned Swedish hooker goes to court for her fee.

text.p: A Swedish prostitute who was stood up by a client refused to take the rejection lying down -- she took him to court.
The 33-year-old woman said the man made a telephone booking last August for a full body massage and sexual intercourse but never showed up, the Stockholm daily Metro said on Wednesday.
"If a customer does not show up at the appointed time at the dentist, the customer is charged for the visit," the prostitute wrote in her plea.
The man agreed to settle out of court and paid her 1,500 crowns (US$200).
